settings.heading_override: Add the digital library to your order
settings.body_override: Totally shareable: every issue as instant PDFs. Reading groups on the whiteboard, lesson inspiration, or the carrot that gets one more draft out of a young writer. It travels home too, for families who want to take the learning further.
